verdict: Spend rose sharply this week; leads fell, and cost per lead doubled.
narrative: In the last 28 days, Maadi Law received 22 leads at an average cost of $153.27 per lead — and the trend inside that window is moving in the wrong direction. Over the most recent 7 days, ad spend rose 86% while leads dropped 9%, pushing the week-over-week cost per lead up 105%. The primary driver is Google Ads, where spend surged 149% with no corresponding lift in leads; a single campaign accounted for $1,437 of the $2,394 spent on Google this period. We are auditing that campaign's budget allocation and tightening spend controls this week to stop the efficiency bleed before the next reporting period.
